    def _ranking_update(self, X, E, S, g):
        g = g.astype(np.float32)
        gV = np.zeros_like(self.V); gW = np.zeros_like(self.W)

        self.t += 1
        b1, b2, eps = 0.9, 0.999, 1e-8
        for P, G, M, Vv in ((self.V, gV, self.mV, self.vV), (self.W, gW, self.mW, self.vW)):
            M *= b1; M += (1 - b1) * G
            Vv *= b2; Vv += (1 - b2) * (G * G)
            P -= self.lr * (M / (1 - b1 ** self.t)) / (np.sqrt(Vv / (1 - b2 ** self.t)) + eps)

    def step_sampled_softmax(self, Xp, Xn):
        X = np.concatenate((Xp[:, None, :], Xn), axis=1)
        B, C, F = X.shape
        flat = X.reshape(B * C, F)
        z, E, S = self.logits(flat)
        z = z.reshape(B, C)
        shifted = z - z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        prob = np.exp(shifted)
        prob /= prob.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        g = prob
        g[:, 0] -= 1.0
        g /= B
        self._ranking_update(flat, E, S, g.reshape(-1))
        return float(-np.mean(np.log(prob[:, 0] + 1.0 + 1e-9)))
